title: Defer unqualified tensor providers and close M7 C02 research
commitMessage: docs: qualify tensor provider deferral and close M7 C02

contribution.summary: Complete M7-W01-C02-T2 as an explicit tensor-provider/API deferral backed by immutable RS108 rank-three shape and 64-element/512-byte refusal evidence. Reexecute independent T1 BCL oracles and document three owner-gated re-entry conditions. Close C02 as a research spike only; M7-W01/M7 remain active, without Tensor product delivery.
contribution.value: An independent C# gate verifies prior source SHA pins, exact 2x2x2 indexing/sum and invalid shape/resource boundaries, plus explicit non-admission of managed/native tensors, broadcasting, sparse and GPU. Require consumer need, shape/budget semantics and provider license/RID/source-free proof before reconsideration.
debtChanges: No new Tensor API or managed/native/GPU tensor runtime is admitted from completed rank-three research fixtures.
Future tensor admission requires a named consumer gap, explicit rank/shape/stride/alias and byte/element budgets.
Require exact source/version/license/RID/rights, offline rollback and independent source-free consumer qualification before any provider cutover.
A research-only 64-element/512-byte cap is not an externally shipped Math performance or numerical guarantee.
M7-W01-C03 is size-L; split before readiness and keep AURA job scheduling/visualization outside Math.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS109 success, prepare only the accepted next M7-W01-C03 research scope after splitting its size-L DAG/PlotModel phase into bounded deliverables; preserve Math/AURA separation, node/point caps and independent 1/x discontinuity and diamond-DAG oracles.

achievements.achievement: Identify the precise consumer, bounded tensor semantics and owner-gated re-entry conditions for research disposition.
Recheck RS108 source SHA identities, independent shape/index/budget oracles and the absent source-free tensor provider evidence.
Explicitly defer new Tensor public APIs and providers; retain Math numerical contracts, ownership boundaries and negative-cutover policy.
Qualify independent C# tensor boundary gate and the three re-entry triggers without implementing a product tensor package.
Close the accepted tensor research spike through evidence-backed deferral, not a delivered Tensor API or provider integration.
